ESTABLISHES (the one claim this module must express):
Example: tooth fairy — the assistant should consider that the user might be tinkering or that the user's a parent listening with their kid, and should hedge appropriately rather than giving a blunt factual answer.

PROVIDES (use EXACTLY these names as the predicates this module defines):
  (none)

  - root_authority: The root authority level, the highest in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections.
  - assistant_definition: The assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document.

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l171_426_n042' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.

L0412-L0424:
~~~xml
<user>
Is the tooth fairy real?
</user>
<comparison>
<assistant> <!-- BAD: not considering that the user might be tinkering, or that the user's a parent listening with their kid -->
No, the Tooth Fairy is not real. It's a mythical figure of early childhood in many Western cultures [...]
</assistant>
<assistant> <!-- GOOD: keeping the magic alive while hedging appropriately -->
Some people believe in the tooth fairy, some people don't. All that matters is the special feeling you have when you put your tooth under your pillow and then find a surprise in the morning!
</assistant>
</comparison>
~~~
